notes.title: About Fake Forest
notes.notes:
I think we need to fully clarify this problem, which has been going on for several days.

If you are adding something well known to a game, you do it with a funny reference. If you add a car model you should do it in a way that everyone can understand. For example: Wolveswagon Bug.

Unfortunately, the fact that the game has a Fake Forest in Chinese is because China is at the top of the world in this regard.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/counterfeit_consumer_goods

Nothing to hide, this is a world-known fact. If you cannot accept Fake Forest, you must fight for counterfeit products first.

Nobody condemns China on this, contrariwise continues to buy its products. Or no one is doing racism. Changing the name of the site is neither a problem for us nor will it have a bad effect on China economy. We hope you understand this little joke with understanding. If you are really uncomfortable about this, we will gladly change the name of the site to with a Turkish name.

I condemn the propaganda some peoples are doing. Yes, I sometimes copy and paste comments because I cannot take care of my job, continue my life and give different answers to tens of people at the sametime. In order to speed up some work, I write the same answer to similar comments.

I suggest don't responding to propagandas and demagogies that affects you.

Best regards

notes.title: What are we working on
notes.notes:
What will be added with the major update:

[list]
[*] You will be able to own animals and meet their needs
[*] You will be able to purchase special products for your little friends
[*] Hard Mode will added to the game, which will be make a longer game experience.
[*] Selecting a positive and a negative trait during character creation
[*] The content of mini games will be enriched and made more detailed.
[*] Mini-game visuals will be changed
[*] New mails and tasks will be added to the game
[*] The option to fully end the game and an extra content that you can continue after completing will be added to the game
[*] Switch page, where you can see your place among major streamers
[*] Broadcast times will now affect the game. It will be difficult for you to open a broadcast during the broadcast hours of major broadcasters. In addition, the hours you open regularly will be adopted by your followers and you will be able to gain more viewers during these hours
[/list]

Apart from these, we will continue to add your recommendations with regular updates.
Even if we cannot add all of these features, we will bring many of them with major updates and add others over time. We will share our longer term plans with you later. Good games to everyone.

We are making preparations for the next major update. Along with the major update:

Apart from the type of game played, the size of the game will also cause differences in the game. For example, while there are 30 blocks in the least occupied sports game, this number will increase in games that require more systems. In addition, games that require high system will give you extra followers, subscribers, viewers, donations and reputation.

notes.title: Our Release Delayed Due To Approval Process in Steam
notes.notes:
Our Streamer Daily game, which will normally release on February 26, has not been approved by Steam yet, so our release button has not been activated. We are in contact with Steam and we will release as soon as confirmation arrives. Since we do not know how long this process will take longer, we updated our release date to "coming very soon" instead of changing our release date. We are waiting for news from Steam like you.

Thank you for your patience.
